name: Tó Madeira
overview:
Luís Franco-Bastos embarks on an unlikely quest—against all odds—to find one of the most enigmatic figures in the world of video games: Tó Madeira.

A legendary striker from *Championship Manager 2000/01* who scored goals, won titles, and captivated thousands of players... despite never having actually existed.

It all begins with a Gouveia jersey and quickly turns into a relentless search that leads him to question what is real and what was born of a digital myth.

Was Tó Madeira merely an invention... or did he truly exist?
